name: Sun Palm
description: Strike with a palm gathered full of sun qi so the blow lands as a flat burst of heat on the target.

name: Warm Hand
description: Lay a warm palm on the bruise of an ally or the self and let sun qi ease the ache away.

name: Heat Press
description: Press the heated palm hard into the guard of an opponent so the warmth bites through cloth and skin.

name: Glow Guard
description: Hold up a hand ringed with a faint glow to turn aside a thrown stone or a glancing blow.

name: Palm Sense
description: Hold a palm out and read the warmth of the bodies nearby to count how many stand close.

name: Sun Brand
description: Touch a glowing palm to an opponent so a hot mark lingers on the skin and stings for a breath.

name: Dawn Breath
description: Draw in the day's first light through slow breaths and let it fill the limbs of the user with fresh vigour.

name: Rising Warmth
description: Breathe warm qi out over the cuts of an ally or the self and watch the skin close slowly.

name: Gold Exhale
description: Blow a hot gold breath in a short cone so it scorches the faces and hands of those before the user.

name: Lung Light
description: Breathe in sharply and feel where the living warmth of the near air is thickest.

name: Steady Glow
description: Keep a steady glow round the chest with each breath so that a light blow slides off the skin.

name: Warm Draught
description: Swallow a mouthful of sun-warmed breath and send it down to settle a pained gut of the self.

name: Breath Flare
description: Puff a small flare of heat from the lips to sting the eyes of an opponent at arm's length.

name: Hard Glare
description: Flash a hard white glare from the eyes so that the sight of an opponent whites out and the next stroke goes wide.

name: Eye Flash
description: Throw a sudden flash from both hands that stings the eyes of everyone looking at the user.

name: Bright Shove
description: Drive a glaring palm into the chest of an opponent and push them back a step on a burst of light.

name: Light Screen
description: Cast a bright screen before the face so that thrown grit and glancing blades are drawn off line.

name: Glint Step
description: Leave a flash behind and step quickly aside while the sight of the opponent is still full of light.

name: Gold Needle
description: Thin a pinch of sun qi into a gold needle and flick it a few paces to prick an opponent.

name: Ray Thread
description: Hold a hair-fine ray on one spot of an opponent until the skin reddens and the guard drops.

name: Twin Rays
description: Loose two rays from two fingers so that the first draws the eye and the second lands.

name: Sun Dart
description: Snap a small dart of hardened light from the wrist in a straight line at the target.

name: Ray Sense
description: Send a thin ray ahead and read from its return how far away the nearest solid thing stands.

name: Ray Fan
description: Spread several rays in a shallow fan so they sting a small group at the same moment.

name: Mending Ray
description: Send a soft ray into the wound of an ally or the self and let it knit the edges slowly.

name: Ray Screen
description: Cross rays before the body into a bright lattice that stops a thrown pebble or a light cut.

name: Kindle Touch
description: Touch a hurt of an ally or the self with fingertips of gentle heat and feel the soreness fade.

name: Ease Heat
description: Spread slow warmth through a stiff and aching limb of an ally or the self until it loosens.

name: Quickening Glow
description: Pour a bright glow into the legs of a tired ally so the stride quickens for a few breaths.

name: Frost Break
description: Warm the numbed fingers and toes of an ally or the self until the blood runs again.

name: Steady Warmth
description: Hold a constant warmth round an ally so the muscles stay loose and the grip stays firm.

name: Warm Sense
description: Rest a hand on a patient and read where the body runs cold and where it burns.

name: Sun Skin
description: Wear a thin bright sheath of sun qi on the skin that turns light blows and shrugs off cold.

name: Plate Glow
description: Thicken the sheath over one forearm into a hard glowing plate to catch a heavier cut.

name: Heat Shed
description: Let the skin flare at the instant of a blow so the strike is thrown off to the side.

name: Radiant Fist
description: Wrap the fist in the sheath and strike so that the knuckles land hot as well as hard.

name: Skin Flare
description: Flare the whole sheath outward in one pulse that singes those pressed close to the user.

name: Warm Cloak
description: Spread the sheath wide over an ally standing at the user's side to guard them from a glancing blow.

name: Bright Elbow
description: Drive a glowing elbow into a ribcage at close quarters and let the heat follow the bone.

name: Sunsense
description: Open the senses to the warmth of living bodies and learn where each one stands in the dark.

name: Far Glow
description: Cast a small steady light ahead of the body and read the shapes it shows in the gloom.

name: Light Bead
description: Roll a bead of bright qi off the fingertips so it bursts in a spark on the first thing it meets.

name: Daystar Spark
description: Throw a hot spark far ahead so it flares against the target and marks it for the next stroke.

name: Glow Step
description: Cast a light a few paces ahead and spring to it in two quick strides.

name: Amber Surge
description: Pull stored warmth up from the blood and send it through the limbs of the user in one strong rush.

name: Amber Mend
description: Draw stored warmth to a wound of the self or an ally and let the blood close it from within.

name: Blood Warmth
description: Warm the blood of a pale and chilled ally until colour returns to the face and hands.

name: Standing Glow
description: Lock the stored warmth into the legs and trunk so that a heavy push cannot shift the user.

name: Amber Fist
description: Throw a fist loaded with stored warmth so the blow lands heavy and burns a little.

name: Vital Rouse
description: Rouse a dazed or sleepy ally with a pulse of vital warmth so the eyes clear and the hands steady.
